parsedVerdict.reasoning: CreateProjectUseCase.execute does normal application-layer orchestration. It builds a domain entity (new Project), saves it through the domain port interface (IProjectRepository.save), and maps the result to an application DTO (ProjectDTO). One could argue this belongs behind an injected IdGenerator port, but generating an identifier during a use case is still an application-level concern.
